claims.statement: Username changes require an unused destination name; the GHES introduction conditions changing the username on built-in authentication. Product availability does not remove authentication prerequisites.

In FPT and GHEC, the former username becomes available for another claimant. Most repository references update automatically, but profile links need not redirect; identity strings are not stable ownership evidence.

The cloud-only trademark section points trademark holders to the separate policy; without a trademark users can choose another or retain the current username, and support cannot release an unavailable name. This receipt does not review or grant legal rights under the linked policy.

Repository references redirect after renaming, but a new holder of the former username creating a same-name repository overrides the redirect. The source recommends updating all existing remote repository URLs; redirects are not a durable custody guarantee.
Old profile-page URLs return 404 after a rename; the source recommends updating externally shared profile links. This differs from repository redirect behavior.
Mobile sessions may display the previous username until logout; sign-out and sign-in on each device is recommended to refresh display, not proof that every external identity reference was updated.

Commits associated with another added account email continue attribution and contribution-graph association. Some GitHub-provided email commits may be affected; details are deferred to an unreviewed linked username reference.
Public and secret gist URLs change after a rename and previous links return 404; the source recommends updating shared gist links. Secret gist status does not supply a redirect exception.

CODEOWNERS references to the previous username require manual updates. The GitHub viewer reports unknown users or users without write access; file existence alone does not prove valid ownership or native review enforcement.
The linked rename how-to is a procedure pointer, not authorization to rename any account; linked remote, trademark and commit-reference pages are not reviewed through this concept receipt.
